questions.prompt: Does recovery require a return to the exact previous state?
questions.answer: No; adaptation may involve changed routines, resources or goals.

questions.prompt: Name two occupational recovery experience categories.
questions.answer: Detachment, relaxation, mastery or control over leisure time.
Conditions and functioning can change, requiring adjustment or further assistance.

questions.prompt: Can a recovery plan certify fitness for work?
questions.answer: No; clinical or occupational clearance belongs with appropriate qualified processes.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer, formative only; use specific feedback and delayed retest.
scoring.practice: Designs a flexible recovery plan, recognises resource changes and distinguishes educational planning from clinical clearance.
scoring.transfer: Complete the fictional recovery plan capstone: adversity and resource map, actionability matrix, consent-based support requests, flexible review plan and explicit boundaries. Compare two possible recovery trajectories and revise the plan after a synthetic change in circumstances.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; never average away missing or safety-critical evidence. Quizzes cannot certify competence.
